title: Call Setter — UK-Based Property Education Sales
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



The Call Setter is a proactive, people-focused role at the very frontline of the TGPC sales pipeline. This position is responsible for inviting leads to webinars, qualifying and booking leads into discovery calls, managing discovery call rebooking, rescheduling and cancellation requests, supporting the live delivery of webinars, confirming upcoming appointments, and managing post-event communication.



What makes this role truly impactful is not just the volume of calls made, but the quality of every human interaction. Our leads are real people considering a life-changing decision — property investment as a route to financial freedom. The Call Setter plays a vital role in that journey. We expect our Call Setters to be warm, genuine, and excited about the work TGPC does, connecting with leads as respected individuals, listening to their goals, and helping them take a step that could genuinely change their lives.



This role is performance-driven, with KPIs covering both quantity (dials made, webinars booked, discovery calls booked) and quality (conversion rates, lead experience, and the standard of every interaction).



The ideal candidate is confident and personable/ friendly on the phone, highly organised, comfortable working with CRM systems and live digital events, and genuinely passionate about property and the transformation TGPC delivers for its students.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Discovery Call Confirmation

Identify upcoming discovery calls for their assigned call closer(s) 24–48 hours in advance within GHL

Contact leads by phone to confirm attendance

Reschedule or cancel appointments as needed

Add relevant notes and updates to lead records in GHL to support Sales Closers rapport building.



Call Setting & Lead Outreach

Identify and prioritise leads for outbound calling campaigns, working with the Sales Manager.

Contact leads by phone to invite them to upcoming webinars

Screen and qualify webinar attendees and registrants  post-webinar, new contacts, previous students and respondents to
 and ad campaigns, and other hot lists,  using the TGPC SPINABT qualification framework

Book pre-qualified leads for discovery calls with closers

Log call outcomes after every call and add detailed notes in GHL after each interaction

Consistently meet and exceed call volume KPIs (dials made, webinars booked, discovery calls booked)

Consistently meet and exceed quality KPIs including DC conversion rates, webinar booking rates, and lead experience standards



Call Setting & Lead Outreach, through Digital Outreach

Identify and prioritise leads for outbound digital outreach campaigns, working with the Sales Manager

Contact leads by digital outreach to invite them to upcoming webinars

Screen and qualify webinar attendees and registrants  post-webinar, new contacts, previous students and respondents to
 and ad campaigns, and other hot lists,  using the TGPC SPINABT qualification framework

Book pre-qualified leads for discovery calls with closers

Log call outcomes after every responded to outreach and add detailed notes in GHL after each interaction

Consistently meet and exceed digital outreach volume KPIs (dials made, webinars booked, discovery calls booked)

Consistently meet and exceed quality KPIs including DC conversion rates, webinar booking rates, and lead experience standards



Webinar Registration & Awareness

Stay informed on all current and upcoming webinar schedules

For the occasional webinar registrant who cannot find the automated webinar link and requests to be resent, access and distribute webinar registration links to leads as required. Note, this webinar link is handled via automaton and is only to be sent manually if the lead cannot find the automated link.





WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



People & Communication

Warm, genuine, and human in every interaction

Confident, clear, and professional phone manner with the ability to build rapport quickly

Able to handle sensitive financial conversations with care and professionalism

Comfortable making high volumes of outbound calls without losing warmth or quality



Sales & Performance

Capable of screening and qualifying leads against set criteria

Driven to meet and exceed both quantity and quality KPIs

Understands that conversion quality — leads who show up, engage, and buy — matters as much as call volume



Organisation & Systems

Experience with CRM platforms, particularly GHL

Strong organisational skills and ability to manage a busy call pipeline

Reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently to deadlines

Meticulous with call notes and CRM record-keeping after every interaction









HOW TO APPLY

Click the link below to fill out our application form. The form includes a short practical task — please allow 45–60 minutes to complete it.

title: Amazon Image Designer
description:
About us

We are UK e-commerce brand selling hats & scarves -  We sell across Amazon UK/EU, Shopify, Etsy and eBay, with multiple product launches planned this year including a new cooling headwear line.



The role

We're looking for a designer with strong judgment and a sharp eye for product realism to own the visual quality of our Amazon catalogue. You won't just execute tasks — you'll audit our listings, decide what needs improving, and drive the work forward.



What you'll do

Audit our catalogue regularly and identify listings where images or A+ Content need updating, refreshing, or rebuilding

Recommend changes with clear reasoning — what's weak, what needs improving, and why

Generate lifestyle and product images using artlist.ai

Update images on Canva - such as making backgraund white or adding text, zoom etc 

Design and update A+ Content modules in Amazon Seller Central

Create full product image sets (main image + 6 secondary images per ASIN)

Quality-check AI-generated images for realism — flagging anything that looks "off"

Adapt designs across UK, DE, FR, IT, ES marketplaces (text overlays in each language)

Keep visual style consistent with our brand



Must-have skills



Strong Canva skills — this is our main design tool

Hands-on experience with Amazon A+ Content modules and Amazon's image requirements

Experience generating product images using artlist.ai or similar AI image tools

Strong judgment on what makes a listing convert — you can look at a listing and tell us what's weak and what should be changed

Self-management skills — able to audit, prioritise, and propose work without being micro-managed

A sharp eye for product realism: you can immediately see when fabric drape, seams, proportions, lighting, or texture look wrong in an AI image

Understanding of Amazon image guidelines (main image rules, pixel requirements, etc.)

Good written English to communicate recommendations clearly



Nice to have



Photoshop or Photopea for finer edits

Experience with apparel, headwear, or fashion brands

Familiarity with multilingual EU listings



Hours & rate : Full time - Rate may change



Your portfolio — specifically A+ Content modules and Amazon product image sets you've designed

2–3 examples of product images you've created using artlist.ai or similar AI tools

description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a sharp, autonomous Amazon Account Specialist to take full ownership of our Seller Central operations. You will be the sole point of contact for customer inquiries, account health, and tactical compliance.

Account Health & "Tactical" Compliance: Monitor account health dashboard daily. Handle restricted product flags, documentation requests, and compliance hurdles. You should be comfortable finding creative, effective ways to resolve "non-traditional" compliance issues and navigating Amazon’s automated systems to keep listings active.



Customer Experience: Manage the daily inbox (typically 1–2 messages per day). Provide high-quality, professional responses that protect our seller rating and resolve buyer issues instantly. 



Seller Central Troubleshooting: Act as the primary liaison with Seller Support. Fight for case resolutions, fix stranded inventory, and update listing data as needed. BRAND ANALYTICS is a REQUIREMENT is needed for this role.

Smart & Adaptive: Since volume is low, we don't need a robot. We need someone who can spend their time researching new workarounds or optimizing a process when things are quiet.



High Level of Discretion: You understand the nuances of compliance in the Amazon world and can execute strategies to keep the account safe without overcomplicating simple tasks.

Ability to work independently with minimal daily supervision.

title: Shopify VA for Product Uploads & Product Page Optimisation
description:
I am looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help manage our product upload and product page optimisation workflow.



This is a long-term role for someone who is comfortable using Shopify, following clear systems, working with AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Higgsfield, and making sure product pages are completed to a high standard.



What You’ll Be Doing



For the first week, we will send you around 50 product links per day. Your role will be to run each product through our provided Claude workflow, monitor the process carefully, and make sure everything is completed correctly before the product page is finalised.



Claude will handle the main product listing work, including the product title, description, product details, and other core listing information. Your job is not to manually write the main product titles or descriptions from scratch.



Instead, you will be responsible for overseeing Claude’s output, following any issues or instructions Claude gives you, checking that the product page is accurate, and making sure everything is completed properly before publishing or moving on to the next product.



You will also be responsible for optimising product pages after Claude has created the listing. We will show you exactly how this needs to be done so every product page matches our store standards and looks clean, professional, and trustworthy.



You will also need to check the product images carefully. All product images must have a clean white background. If Claude generates an image incorrectly, you will need to regenerate the image using Higgsfield. If an image does not have a white background, you will need to use ChatGPT to generate or fix the image so it matches our store standards.



Once you become familiar with our store, product style, and the types of products we sell, you will gradually start finding suitable product links yourself and running them through the same process.



Main Responsibilities



Run product links through our Claude workflow



Monitor Claude’s output and follow any instructions or issues it gives you



Oversee the product upload process inside Shopify



Optimise product pages after the listing has been created



Check product images and make sure they have a white background



Regenerate incorrect images using Higgsfield when needed



Use ChatGPT to fix or generate images when the background is not suitable



Check that product pages look clean, accurate, and professional



Follow our process carefully and consistently



Eventually help find suitable product links for the store



Maintain a high standard across all products added to the website



What We’re Looking For



Experience using Shopify



Comfortable using Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, or similar AI tools



Strong attention to detail



Able to follow instructions carefully



Good eye for clean product pages and store presentation



Reliable, honest, and consistent with daily tasks



Able to work independently after training



Able to check AI-generated work instead of blindly trusting it



Experience with pet products, dropshipping, Google Shopping, or SEO is a bonus, but not required



Important Standards



We care about quality. Product pages should not look rushed, messy, copied, or generic. Every product needs to be checked carefully and presented in a way that feels trustworthy to customers.



Speed is important, but accuracy matters more. Once trained, you should be able to process around 50 products per day and optimise the product pages while keeping a high standard.



About the Role



This will start with a training and onboarding period where we provide the product links, Claude prompts, examples, and instructions. You will learn what our product pages should look like and how our workflow works.



After that, the role will become more independent. You will manage the product workflow, oversee Claude’s output, optimise product pages, check product images, fix image issues when needed, and eventually help find suitable products for the store.



How to Apply



Please apply with:



A short explanation of your Shopify experience



Examples or links to stores or product pages you have worked on before, if available



A brief explanation of your experience using Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, or other AI tools



Confirmation that you are comfortable processing around 50 products per day and optimising product pages once trained



Reply with the word GREEN at the top of your application so we know you have read the full job post.

title: Vibe Coder – Remote On-the-Job Training (OJT)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Duration: 6-month OJT (potential full-time conversion)

Hours: 40 hours/week

Stipend: TBD (open for discussion based on experience)

Updated: June 2026



THE ROLE

You'll be building the actual software that runs our ventures — and learning how real software gets shipped in a

live, fast-moving business environment.

We don't have time for slow sprints. We have more ideas than hands. Dashboards our clients demand. Internal

tools our teams stitch together in spreadsheets. Client-facing portals that need to exist. Snap & Prospect

automation pipelines. And someone needs to make them real.

That someone is you — but we'll teach you how.



What you'll actually do:

• Build real, shipped tools — not homework projects. CRM enrichment scripts, onboarding workflows,

recruiter dashboards, automation glue between Gmail/Sheets/Telegram/Slack. You'll see your code running in

production within weeks, not months.

• Learn by doing — We'll pair you with our team on live builds. You'll see what good code looks like (and what

bad code looks like). You'll learn when an AI is being helpful vs. when it's confidently wrong. You'll ship messy

v1s and iterate based on real feedback.

• Own the full loop — Spec (usually from a Slack message or voice note), build, deploy, iterate. We give

direction; you ship.

• Treat AI as a co-builder, not a crutch — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — these are your tools. You'll learn

to work with AI, not just at AI.

• Move fast — When someone says "what if we…", you'll prototype something demo-able in a day or two, not

request a Gantt chart



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You don't need 5 years of experience. You need the right foundation and mindset.

Must-have:

? Technically capable — You've built something that ran. A side project. A class assignment you actually

finished. A startup idea you coded. It doesn't need to be polished; it needs to be real.

? AI-native — You think in AI. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily. You can articulate your actual

workflow (not "I sometimes use Copilot"). You're comfortable asking an LLM for code and know how to spot

when it's lying.

? Systems thinking — Either you're a CS/IT student or recent grad who understands databases, APIs, and

deployment, OR you're a business/entrepreneurship student who's built a venture or prototype and understands

how systems need to work to solve real problems.

? Hunger to ship — You get frustrated by endless meetings. You want to see your work in the world. You're

willing to learn in public.

? Communication — Half our briefs come as voice notes. You're okay with ambiguity and can ask clarifying

questions without needing a 30-page spec.

Nice to have:

? You've built something with Claude Code or Cursor and can talk about what worked/didn't

? You're comfortable with: Next.js, React Native, FastAPI, Node, Supabase, Vercel

? You've touched:
 bots, Gmail/Drive APIs, automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier)

? You understand business tools: CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive), recruiting ops, or SME workflows

? You're based in the Philippines and understand SEA or Australian SME operations



THE OJT ADVANTAGE

This isn't a typical internship. You're not making coffee or organizing files.

? You'll ship real code to real users within your first month

? You'll learn modern development the way it's actually done in 2026 — with AI as a first-class teammate

? You'll work across the full stack — no "frontend only" silos; you'll touch API design, database schemas,

deployment, customer feedback loops

? You'll build a portfolio of deployed projects you can show future employers

? You'll earn a stipend (negotiable) + potential full-time offer at the end if it's a good fit

? You'll be paid for your time — not exploited as free labor



HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. A short note (200 words max) on:

• The most interesting thing you've built (could be a hackathon project, class assignment, side project, startup

idea)

• What it does

• What tools you used (especially if you used AI)

• What you'd do differently if you built it again

2. Show your work:

• GitHub links (even half-finished projects)

• Deployed apps or links to live projects

• Screenshots, demo videos, or Loom walkthroughs

• If you built something with Claude Code or Cursor, please include it

3. Optional but encouraged (60–90 minutes):

Pick one and build it using Claude Code, Cursor, or your favorite AI-native tool. Don't polish it. Send us the

messy version + a 2-minute Loom walkthrough explaining what you built and what you'd change.

Option A: A CSV-to-personalized
 generator (upload contacts ? generate personalized drafts)

Option B: A
 bot that logs voice notes into a Google Sheet with auto-generated summaries

Option C: A mini dashboard that pulls from a public API (weather, crypto prices, GitHub repos, whatever) and

displays something useful



Send your code + Loom to:

Short-form clips - Reels, TikToks, Shorts. Finding the best 
nts, crafting hooks, making videos people actually watch.

nts that will hit

nts

nts and string them together with music and pacing

title: [Remote] Senior Meta Ads Growth Specialist (E-commerce / DTC)
description:
BLUE. To diagnose a sudden drop in a Meta Ads conversion campaign before touching any budgets, I would first check the Ad Set frequency and creative fatigue metrics to see if the target audience is burned out. Next, I would verify the Meta Pixel and Conversions API (CAPI) status in Events Manager to ensure there are no data drops or deduplication errors. Finally, I would analyze the hook rate (3-second video view / impression) and hold rate of the creatives to pinpoint whether the issue is a sudden drop in ad engagement or a broken flow on the Shopify landing page.



FILTER — read first: To prove you read this, start your reply with the word “BLUE” and answer these three exact questions in your application:

(1) How do you structure your creative testing framework within Meta (ABO vs CBO)?

(2) What specific experience do you have scaling clothing or lifestyle DTC brands?

(3) What are your exact mathematical decision rules for doubling a winning ad set budget versus killing a losing creative?

Applications without the codeword and these three answers will be ignored.



We're Anzivota Digital, a global digital marketing agency. This is a strategy and heavy scaling role, not a routine campaign setup or graphic design role. We need a high-level Meta Ads Specialist who lives and breathes
/Instagram paid acquisition, maintains strict CAC/ROAS control, and knows how to scale winners profitably. If you are a general social media manager or a content poster, this is not for you. We focus entirely on data, rapid creative testing, and bottom-line spend efficiency.



We need ONE experienced, analytical media buyer to take full ownership of our e-commerce clients' Meta advertising. You personally do the work — no agencies, no sub-contracting.



Core Responsibilities

Campaign Management (Daily): Launch, monitor, and aggressively optimize campaigns across Meta Ads Manager. Ensure absolute tracking accuracy using Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), and clean UTM setups.



Creative Testing & Iteration: You will not design graphics, but you MUST be a master of creative strategy. You will test ad creatives based on clear psychological angles, hooks, and direct-response copywriting rules.



Budget Allocation & Scaling: Dynamically allocate daily spend based on hard performance. Identify winning ad sets/creatives and scale them using systematic frameworks (CBO scaling, cost caps, or horizontal scaling). Cut underperforming elements quickly.



How We Work

We operate using clear mathematical decision rules, not vague gut feelings. Examples:



Kill a new creative after $X spend if the outbound CTR is below X% or CPA is 1.5x over target.



Scale a winning CBO budget by 20% every 48 hours if ROAS stays above target and frequency is stable.



One major optimization variable changed at a time, logged with reasoning, followed by a weekly 30-minute alignment review.



Must Haves

3+ years of direct, hands-on experience managing Meta Ads specifically for E-commerce / DTC Shopify brands.



Deep understanding of Meta Ads account architecture (CBO, ABO, Advantage+, Cost Caps).



Ability to break down video/image creative performance (Hook rates, Hold rates, CTR, Conversion Rate).



Proven experience managing international budgets (US, Canada, or Australia markets).



Strong English communication skills.



Tech Stack / Key Terms

Meta Ads Manager,
 Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Shopify, ROAS, CAC, CPA, Hook Rate, Hold Rate, Creative Testing.

title: Financial Operations Specialist
description:
Seeking a highly detail-oriented Senior Financial Operations Specialist to take full ownership of end-to-end financial operations across benefit programs. This role is critical in ensuring financial integrity, accurate reporting, and scalable processes.



You will serve as the accountable owner of reconciliation, ledger accuracy, and financial process documentation, working closely with an external accounting firm initially. The ideal candidate operates with extreme autonomy, utilizing AI tools to drive efficiency and ensuring perfect GAAP compliance without management overhead. A key success metric for this role is the strategic transition of our client’s full bookkeeping and compliance function from external partners to internal ownership within your first year. 



The role is structured in two phases:

- Phase 1 (60–90 days): Historical backlog cleanup, reconciliation of past payments, resolution of discrepancies to establish a clean ledger, and process stabilization.

- Phase 2 (Ongoing): Weekly reconciliations, ledger maintenance, discrepancy investigation, continuous process improvement, and transition into expanded ownership of bookkeeping responsibilities



Key Responsibilities:

Financial Systems & Ledger Ownership

- Maintain a clean and accurate ledger, tracking approved benefit amounts, pending balances, payments, and precise timestamps.

- Reconcile payment records against approved benefit amounts on both a weekly and historical basis.

- Track and reconcile fund transfers to third-party payment partners against disbursement records.

- Take full ownership of the financial operations for the SLRA and TRS service lines, ensuring they run without constant management oversight.  

Compliance, Audit & Tax Control

- Ensure every outgoing payment is tied to an approved request and that all bank transfers maintain a complete audit trail.

- Manage all GAAP accounting standards and US tax compliance requirements, specifically focusing on 1099 filings.

- Perform deep-dive investigations into overpayments, underpayments, or missing payments to identify the root cause.

- Serve as the primary point of escalation for payment-related issues, resolving them internally before they reach clients or leadership.

Strategic Transition & Optimization

- Lead the 9-month transition to move all bookkeeping functions from the external accounting firm to internal ownership.  

- Identify and implement AI tools to automate manual reconciliation tasks and increase the efficiency of the finance function.  

- Build and maintain an "edge case library" that documents unique rules and handling scenarios to ensure consistent decision-making.

- Document and refine all financial processes to eliminate repeat decision-making and support future scalability.

Operational Support & Ad Hoc Analysis

- Assist with special reconciliations and reporting requests, ensuring high data integrity for all financial reporting.

- Participate in system clean-up initiatives and proactive process improvement exercises as assigned.

- Handle time-sensitive or non-standard requests from the finance or operations teams to support evolving business needs.



Requirements & Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance (required; non-negotiable)

- Minimum 2 years of experience in Financial Operations, Reconciliation, AP/AR, or bookkeeping

- Strong attention to detail with a proactive ownership mindset; focused on root cause analysis, not just resolution

- Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets, including reconciliation tracking, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, and structured data logging

- Experience working with financial/transactional data, including bank statements, payment records, and general ledgers

- Strong written English skills for documenting processes, rules, and findings

- Experience with GAAP accounting and US tax compliance, including 1099 filing requirements (required)

- Experience with US companies or US accounting standards (required)

- Comfortable working in evolving environments and building processes from the ground up

- AI Proficiency: Must be "AI forward" and able to explain specifically how AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, or specialized fintech AI) enhance their current role and efficiency. 

- Two professional references and a valid criminal background check issued within the last 60 days are required for all successful applicants.

- Completion of intake paperwork, including submission of a valid tax identification number (e.g., Social Security Number, Social Insurance Number, or the country’s equivalent), is required before onboarding.



Working Hours:

Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time



Pay: $1200+ $75 Allowance per month

- Financial Operations

Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you will have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star customer service to all of our clients, and all of our tea
mbers are accountable for fulfilling this.



We’re looking for long-term, ongoing cooperation.



The ideal candidate loves talking to people and proactively solving issues. You will be responsible for converting customers into passionate evangelists.



Work schedules may vary depending on business needs, including mid-shift assignments. The available shifts are:



8:00 AM – 4:00 PM US Eastern Time (8:00 PM – 4:00 AM Philippine Time)

4:00 PM – 12:00 AM US Eastern Time (4:00 AM – 12:00 PM Philippine Time)



This position requires working 8 hours per day, 5 days per week. Your two days off will be scheduled in coordination with your manager. While we will make every effort to accommodate your preferred days off, scheduling will ultimately depend on business needs.



Occasionally, a sixth workday may be required based on business demands. Any such additional day will be compensated as paid overtime.



This role is available to start as soon as possible.



As a Customer Service Representative at Five Star Retail Brands, a typical day will include the following:



- Provide excellent customer support through inbound and outbound calls,
s, live chat, and text messages

- Provide knowledgeable answers to questions about the product, pricing, and availability

- Work with internal departments to meet customers' needs

- Cooperate with other tea
mbers and report to the superiors

- Process cancellations, refunds, and returns

- Communicate with the warehouse to ensure we’re delivering all orders on time

- Update customers about the status of their orders

- Archiving
s



What you need:



- At least 6 months of experience in customer service on the phone (voice)

- Excellent spoken English and confidence in speaking on the phone

- Long-term commitment - treat this as your career

- Excellent phone etiquette and excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills

- Ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize work

- Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

- Experience working in a remote setup is a plus



What we can offer:



- Paid training on all aspects of the role

- Competitive starting salary USD: $1,000 / month

- Overtime (if approved by the manager) is paid at the same rate as base salary

- 15 paid days off per year (with an option to convert them to cash if not used)

- Fully remote position

- Opportunities for professional development

- After a few months to a year with the company, you might receive a promotion to the Operations team, which has a higher earning potential

- Friendly atmosphere

- Online Interview Process

title: Personal Executive Assistant (June2026)
description:
Full-time Personal Executive Assistant: Personal and Business duties Overview:

1. About the Role: I am looking for a professional, reliable, long-term Personal Executive Assistant who can support both the owner’s personal and business responsibilities. This role involves working directly with the owner to support his work managing multi-step tasks in multiple work areas: real estate development, photo and film studio, property management, leasing, construction, business operations, tennis sports management, family scheduling, travel logistics, and other one-time, unique tasks. 

2. The personal executive assistant will assist the owner in managing a constant stream of unique situations and to help extend his execution reach by keeping tasks moving forward to the point where he can make a decision. On a daily basis, you will be analyzing, anticipating, problem-solving, organizing, researching, communicating with partners and presenting, and collaborating. I value daily consistency, resourcefulness and initiative. This is not a flexible data-entry or call-center position.

3. Overnight Shift: 

a. Full-time position Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm PDT (Pacific Daylight Time) California time, with 1-hour lunch starting at 12:00pm. 

b. In Philippines time (PHT), this is Tuesday through Saturday 11:00am to 9:00am (overnight shift) with a 1-hour meal break starting at 3:00am.

4. Approximately 50% Personal and 50% Business work intertwined throughout the day.

5. Ideal candidate will have 3-5 years previous experience in comprehensive, deep support of one executive rather than supporting multiple executives in a limited capacity.



Personal Work Activities

1. Scheduling and Calendar Management

2. Processing all scanned mail

3. Schedule Manage Medical appointments and payments

4. Order and monitor the monthly medications

5. Support daughter’s tennis development, tournament travel, and paying Tennis Team expenses via Venmo.

6. Monthly travel planning for family for flights, hotels and car rentals

7. Purchasing on Amazon, Tennis Warehouse and other online vendors

8. Cost management

9. Other miscellaneous tasks.



Business Work Activities

1. Manage calendar &
 inbox — summarizing, clarifying, flagging priorities

2. Coordinate with vendors, service providers, tenants as needed

3. Track ongoing issues until resolved (follow-through focus)

4. Assisting the Owner to oversee the Photo Studio operations and Milk Tea shop construction and the respective associated current VAs

5. Using Microsoft Excel spreadsheets for basic cost analysis and monthly tracking. 

6. Property Management for the family’s properties including listings and tenant management.

7. Assist with Real Estate Multi-Family Investments and Liaise with Realtors

8. Actively monitor deadlines and pay expenses and property taxes, 

9. Cost management and reduction: Utilities, Insurance, Internet

10. Filing routine annual documents to various government agencies related to properties and businesses

11. Organizing digital folders and filing documents to Dropbox 

12. Manage priorities, tasks and duties using Click-Up 

13. Other miscellaneous tasks per request



Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

Please only apply if you meet all of the following:

1. 3+ years as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator or Event Planner.

2. Excellent English — both spoken and written (you will be customer-facing and vendor facing)

3. Very strong organization + follow-through skills

4. Ability to work with autonomy (low supervision needed) and collaboratively (excellent communication skills).

5. Able to take notes, follow instructions, and close loops

6. Stable internet, quiet work environment, and reliable power



Ideal Fit

You are someone who:

1. Likes being someone’s right-hand

2. Has the ability to absorb multiples tasks at one time and then funnel them into priorities, bundles and subtasks. 

3. Resourcefully problem-solves to push through obstacles

4. Anticipate needs and reminds proactively

5. Can comfortable saying, “Here is what’s pending and what I need from you”

6. Takes initiative — you do not wait to be chased for updates

7. Communicates clearly and professionally.

8. Asks clarifying questions when needed — you don’t guess.

9. Enjoys improving organization, not just completing tasks.

10. Wants a long-term professional relationship (not short gigs).





Tools We Use 

(Experience with several is expected)

1. Intermediate Microsoft Office: write formal letters and notices

2. Intermediate Microsoft Excel: organizing data sets, performing simple functions, experienced in formatting for presentations

3. Dropbox: experienced with filing large volumes of documents

4. Google Workspace: Gmail, Calendar, and Chrome

5. Text and Phone Coordination: Google Voice, Google Chat 

6. Task/Project tracking: ClickUp



How to Apply (Read Carefully)

Applications that do not follow these steps will not be considered. Please send:

1. Your expected hourly rate

2. A 1-minute video (
, youtube):

        a. Introduce yourself & your past EA experience. 

        b. One example of a task where your resourcefulness was needed to resolve the issue.

3. Your Resume

4. One example of a written message you’ve drafted in a previous role 
 or memo — you may redact details).

5. Please confirm you can work overnight shift Mon-Fri from 8am to 5pm PDT (California time). In PHT, this would be Tuesday to Saturday 11:00pm to 8:00am. 8hrs/day x 40hrs/week

6. Please confirm you will be able to provide 1-2 professional references from executives where you worked as their full-time Executive Assistant.

title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.)



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

title: CapCut Video Editor - Night Shift, High-Volume, Long-Term

Looking for a long-term tea
mber who is interested in growing together and can potentially commit to 5–6 hours per day in the future as additional brands and workload are added.

VOLUME EXPECTATION:

This role includes editing approximately 14 short-form organic videos per day.



Most edits are simple UGC/TikTok-style videos with consistent editing styles and repeatable workflows. Many videos follow similar formats and often reuse the same video body/editing style week-to-week, making the process faster once trained.



There will also be a smaller number of videos that require a bit more effort, but they are still organic-style edits (not highly produced or complex).

• Takes feedback well and applies it to future videos

AVAILABILITY REQUIREMENT:

We are based in Toronto (EST), so some deadlines align with EST hours.

Mondays require overnight/night-shift availability (Philippines time), and after that, most edits follow a 20-24 hour turnaround schedule.



START DATE:

Looking for someone who can start as early as Monday, June 22 (EST) for upcoming edits.



RATE:

$3–$4 USD/hour, based on experience. Paid monthly via PayPal.



TO APPLY:

Start your subject line with the word “MANGO” (applications without this keyword will not be reviewed).



In your application, please include:

• Your portfolio link (UGC/TikTok-style edits preferred)

• Confirmation that you meet the must-haves above

• Your CapCut experience level

• How many hours per day you can commit



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT:

If your application is a fit, we’ll send a short test project (1 raw video, 24-hour turnaround). Strong test results can lead to a long-term position.

title: Supabase & Vercel Developers
description:
Job Description: Supabase & Vercel Developer

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with frontend frameworks, serverless deployments, backend services, databases, authentication, APIs, and scalable cloud-based workflows.



Responsibilities

Build and maintain web applications using Vercel, Supabase, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks.

Set up and manage Supabase projects, including PostgreSQL databases, authentication, storage, edge functions, and real-time features.

Deploy, configure, and optimize applications on Vercel.

Connect frontend applications with Supabase backend services.

Create and manage database tables, relationships, queries, indexes, and security policies.

Implement user authentication, login systems, role-based access, and protected routes.

Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code.

Troubleshoot deployment, database, API, and performance issues.

Work with APIs, serverless functions, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

Collaborate with designers, project managers, and other developers to complete projects on time.

Maintain documentation for setup, deployment, and backend structure.

Requirements

Strong experience with Supabase and Vercel.

Experience with Next.js, React, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript.

Good understanding of PostgreSQL databases.

Experience setting up Supabase authentication, storage, edge functions, and Row Level Security policies.

Ability to deploy and manage production applications on Vercel.

Experience working with REST APIs, serverless functions, and backend integrations.

Understanding of frontend performance, SEO-friendly development, and responsive design.

Ability to debug issues across frontend, backend, and deployment environments.

Good communication skills and ability to work independently.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Tailwind CSS.

Experience with GitHub, Git workflows, and CI/CD.

Knowledge of Stripe, Resend, Clerk, OAuth, or other common SaaS integrations.

Experience building dashboards, SaaS platforms, admin panels, booking systems, or marketplaces.

Familiarity with database migrations and production environment management.

Job Type



Remote / Freelance / Part-Time / Full-Time



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is reliable, detail-oriented, and able to take a project from development to deployment. They should understand how to structure a Supabase backend, connect it to a modern frontend, and deploy everything smoothly through Vercel.



How to Apply



Please send your resume, portfolio, GitHub profile, and examples of projects you have built using Supabase, Vercel, Next.js, or similar technologies.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER (GHL SPECIALIST)

Go Ignite  |  Fully Remote  |  Monday-Friday  |  7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

PHP 80,000/month + OTE  |  Prepaid HMO  |  Paid Time Off



If you can build a full GHL white label environment from scratch, run paid ads that convert, and own results end-to-end -- read on. 



If you have never led a team, need hand-holding, prefer to execute someone else's strategy, or are not ready to commit to a full 8-hour day with an international team -- this role is not for you.



Go Ignite is hiring one person for this role. We are not filling a seat. We are building our internal digital engine, and we need someone who has done this before at a high level.



This role is NOT for you if:

You have only used GHL as an end-user - proven sub-account builds, white label setups, and A2P/10DLC experience are required

You have never managed paid campaigns for Australian or US-based clients

You cannot show us real outcomes: funnels you built, ads you ran, metrics that moved

You are looking for someone to tell you what to do every day

You have never led, coordinated, or managed a marketing team or direct reports

 

About Go Ignite

Go Ignite is the growth and technology division of a specialist international recruitment group connecting top Filipino talent with high-growth Australian and US businesses. We build the systems -- the funnels, automations, and campaigns - that power candidate attraction and client conversion at scale. This is an internal hire. You will own the tools that drive the business.



The Role

You will lead the Go Ignite marketing function. The marketing team reports directly to you, giving leadership full visibility without day-to-day involvement. You own the GHL ecosystem, drive paid campaign performance, and set the standard for how the team executes and grows. This is a player-coach role -- you build, you lead, and you are accountable for results.



These are the five areas you will own:



Team Leadership & Direction

Lead and coordinate the Go Ignite marketing team -- you are the go-to for direction, prioritisation, and performance

Set weekly priorities, run team check-ins, and ensure campaigns and systems are moving without requiring escalation to the owner

Build and maintain SOPs so the team operates to a consistent standard and scales without bottlenecks

Report to the business owner on team performance, key wins, and strategic recommendations.



GHL Systems & Automation

Full white label environment management: sub-account setup, affiliate manager configuration, A2P/10DLC registration and compliance

Build and maintain lead generation funnels, automation workflows, nurture sequences, appointment booking flows, and CRM pipelines from scratch

Provide technical support and troubleshoot across workflows, deliverability, domains, and third-party integrations

Develop SOPs and documentation so systems scale without you as a single point of failure.



Paid Advertising

Plan, launch, and optimise paid campaigns across Meta 
/Instagram), Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube -- ad creatives and copy are supplied by the team

A/B test audiences, landing pages, and ad sets using performance data and AI-driven insights

Manage CPL, ROAS, and conversion targets across Australian and US market campaigns



Web, Integrations & Landing Pages

Maintain WordPress sites: forms, tracking pixels, domain configuration, webhooks, Zapier integrations

Build high-converting landing pages that support campaign objectives



Analytics, Reporting & Social

Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports across GHL dashboards, Google Analytics, and ad platforms

Support social media content scheduling and brand presence using AI tools and content calendars

Recommend improvements across funnels, paid ads, and
/SMS campaigns based on data. 



What You Must Bring

3+ years hands-on experience as a GHL Specialist or Digital Marketer -- not as a VA who uses GHL, but as someone who builds in it

Proven full white label GHL setup experience: sub-account creation, affiliate manager config, A2P/10DLC registration

Demonstrated paid ads results on Meta and/or Google Ads for Australian or US clients -- you have screenshots, ROAS data, or client outcomes to show us

WordPress integration skills: pixels, tracking, domains, webhooks, Zapier

Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, or similar) for content and automation tasks

Excellent written and spoken English -- you communicate directly with an international team daily

Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating a marketing team -- you know how to set direction, give feedback, and drive accountability

Self-directed, organised, and able to manage multiple campaigns and people without daily supervision

 

Why This Role Stands Apart



Most GHL roles in the Philippines are VA-level: follow the SOP, raise a ticket, wait for approval. This is not that.

You own the GHL ecosystem -- architecture decisions are yours

You work directly with the leadership team, not through layers of management

You see the full picture: how funnels feed ads, how ads feed the pipeline, how the pipeline drives revenue

You lead the marketing team -- this is a genuine step into a Head of Marketing function

International exposure with Australian and US market campaigns -- resume-building work with real accountability 

Compensation & Benefits



PHP 80,000/month base + OTE

Base salary: PHP 80,000/month. On-target earnings (OTE) are payable on top of base, tied to agreed performance outcomes. Total compensation for a strong performer exceeds base.

Prepaid HMO (ask us about dependent coverage options)

Paid Time Off

Fully remote -- work from anywhere in the Philippines

Full-time, 40 hours/week | Monday-Friday | 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM Manila Time

Direct access to leadership and real career growth as the business scales



How to Apply

We review every application personally. We do not shortlist candidates who skip these steps.

1. Your updated CV

2. A 2-3 minute video introduction: who you are, why this role is the right next step, and a walkthrough of one GHL build you are proud of

3. Your portfolio -- funnels, automations, ad campaign results,
 sequences -- anything with measurable outcomes (Google Drive, Notion, or Loom links are fine).

4. A written answer to the screening question below, included in your application message

Screening Question (required):

Walk us through a GHL white label setup you have completed end-to-end. What did the configuration involve? How did you handle A2P/10DLC registration? What did the finished client environment look like, and what were the results for the client?



Applications without a written answer to this question will not be reviewed.

If your application is strong, you will hear from us within 3-5 business days.

title: Brand identity designer
description:
Brand Identity Designer Needed – Luxury Medical Aesthetics Relaunch

About Forever Young

Forever Young Laser Skin Rejuvenation is an established medical aesthetics clinic located in Edmonton, Alberta. For over 15 years, we have built our reputation through exceptional client care, advanced technology, and results-driven treatments. Today, we are proud to have over 1,600 five-star reviews and multiple industry and consumer awards.

As our business continues to evolve, we are undertaking a complete brand refinement and relaunch. While our reputation and success are well established, we feel our current branding no longer reflects the level of sophistication, innovation, and expertise we offer today.

Our website, social media platforms, marketing systems, and client-facing materials are currently in the design and redevelopment phase as part of this relaunch.

Project Overview

We are seeking an experienced brand designer to help develop a cohesive and elevated brand identity that will serve as the foundation for our relaunch and future growth.

This is not a startup brand. This is the evolution of a successful business that has spent 15 years building trust, results, and a loyal client base.

While our website and social media platforms are currently being redesigned, we believe the brand foundation must be established first. We are looking for a designer who can help define the visual identity that will guide all future touchpoints, including our website, social media, digital materials, in-clinic experience, advertising, and client education assets.

Who We Are

Advanced Laser Skin Rejuvenation

RF Microneedling

Skin Tightening

Medical Facials

Injectables

Hair Services

Brows & Lashes

Nail Services

Waxing

Skin health

Skin longevity

Advanced diagnostics

Corrective treatments

Layered technologies

Long-term outcomes

We are not trend-driven. We are results-driven.

We want clients to feel confident that they are receiving expert recommendations backed by experience, technology, education, and proven results.

The Relaunch

This relaunch represents the next chapter of Forever Young.

Over the past year we have invested heavily in new technologies, treatment protocols, education, skincare partnerships, systems, and the overall patient experience.

Website

Social Media Presence

Brand Identity

Digital Service Guides

 Marketing

Client Education Materials

In-Clinic Signage

Marketing Assets

Promotional Materials

Consultation Resources

We want our brand to communicate:

Established and trusted

Results-driven

Technology-focused

Medical and professional

Luxurious yet approachable

Sophisticated

Modern

Timeless

Innovative

Educational

Minimal

Elevated

Editorial

Modern Medical

Refined

High-End

Premium layouts

Real clinic imagery

Brand guidelines

Graphic elements

 templates

s.

title: Full-Stack Developer / AI-Assisted Product Engineer
description:
# Full-Stack Developer / AI-Assisted Product Engineer



## Job Type



Full-time or long-term part-time

Remote

Long-term position for the right person



## About the Role



I am looking for a smart, reliable, detail-oriented software developer from the Philippines who can help build real business software products from idea to working application.



This is not just a basic coding job. I am looking for someone who can think like a product engineer: understand requirements, ask good questions, build clean features, test their own work, and use AI tools intelligently to move faster.



You will work directly with me on software projects for businesses. Many of the projects involve internal business systems, dashboards, admin portals, automation tools, AI-assisted workflows, reporting tools, customer portals, and integrations.



The ideal person is someone who is very comfortable learning, solving problems, and using modern AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar development assistants.



## Responsibilities



You may help with:



* Building web applications from requirements

* Frontend development using Angular, React, or similar frameworks

* Backend development using ASP.NET Core, Node.js, or similar backend frameworks

* Working with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL

* Creating clean APIs

* Building admin panels, dashboards, forms, workflows, and reporting pages

* Writing unit tests, integration tests, and basic end-to-end tests

* Debugging and fixing issues

* Reading existing codebases and understanding how they work

* Using AI tools to speed up development while still verifying the output

* Writing simple technical documentation and handoff notes

* Helping turn business requirements into clear software features



## Required Skills



You should have experience with at least the following:



* JavaScript / TypeScript

* Angular, React, or Vue

* ASP.NET Core

* REST APIs

* SQL databases

* Git / GitHub

* HTML, CSS, responsive UI

* Playwright, Cypress, or other testing tools

* Experience with AI coding tools

* Debugging and problem solving

* Good written English

* Ability to explain what you built and why



## Nice to Have



These are not required, but they are a big plus:



* NodeJS

* Angular

* PostgreSQL or SQL Server

* Entity Framework Core

* Experience building SaaS products

* Experience with business software, CRM, ERP, inventory, accounting, ecommerce, or reporting systems

* WordPress experience

* Basic DevOps / deployment knowledge



## What I Am Looking For



I care more about intelligence, honesty, and problem-solving ability than perfect credentials.



You should be:



* Very reliable

* Honest about what you know and do not know

* Good at communicating progress

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear

* Careful with details

* Interested in long-term work

* Willing to learn new tools and frameworks

* Able to test your own work before saying it is done



## Important



Please do not apply if you only copy and paste AI-generated code without understanding it.



AI tools are welcome and encouraged, but you must be able to review the code, fix problems, explain your work, and make sure the final result actually works.



## Work Style



You will receive clear tasks, requirements, and acceptance criteria. For larger tasks, you may be asked to help break down requirements, identify missing questions, and suggest better ways to build the product.



I prefer someone who can give daily updates, communicate clearly, and show working progress often.



## Hours



Flexible schedule is okay, but I need consistent availability and reliable communication.



Please include your preferred schedule and how many hours per week you are available.



## Compensation



Please include your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in your application.



I am looking for a long-term working relationship. If you are talented, reliable, and improve over time, there will be room to grow.



## How to Apply



When applying, please answer these questions:



1. What is your experience with frontend development? Which framework do you know best?

2. What is your experience with backend development?

3. What databases have you worked with?

4. Have you used AI coding tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools? If yes, how do you use them?

5. Describe the most complex software project you have worked on.

6. Send links to your GitHub, portfolio, or previous work if available.

7. What is your expected hourly rate or monthly salary?

8. How many hours per week are you available?

9. What is your internet speed and computer setup?

10. In one paragraph, explain how you would approach building a simple customer order management system with login, customers, orders, order statuses, and an admin dashboard.



Please start your application with the words: **“Product Engineer Applicant”** so I know you read the full post.

Position Overview

The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on Quickbase platform experience, strong problem-solving instincts, and the communication skills to collaborate closely with our internal team during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Quickbase Development

Integrations and Automation

title: CPA US Tax Preparer (Lacerte Tax Software)
description:
Our client, a US-based public accounting firm, is hiring a remote Tax Preparer (CPA) to prepare and review individual, business, and trust tax returns in full compliance with federal and state tax regulations. This is a hands-on preparer seat — you will own returns from source-document intake through reviewer handoff and e-file, working directly inside Lacerte tax software.



This role is built for a tax professional who has already logged real public accounting cycles: someone who can open a prior-year 1120S, reconcile to current-year trial balance, identify the M-1 adjustments, allocate K-1 items correctly, run Lacerte diagnostics, and prepare a clean workpaper file the reviewer can sign off on without rework. You'll communicate directly with US clients to request missing documents, explain results, and respond to filing questions, so written and verbal English fluency is non-negotiable.



The team operates remote-first with async-default communication. During US peak season (February through April 15, plus the September–October extension window), return volume scales significantly and deadline discipline becomes the differentiator between candidates who succeed and candidates who don't. Outside of peak, the work shifts toward tax planning support, estimated tax calculations, projections, and notice response.



You will report to a US-based reviewer or tax manager. Success at 90 days means your returns pass first-round review with minimal diagnostics, your client communication is professional and timely, and your workpaper documentation is organized enough that any reviewer can pick up your file mid-engagement.



Responsibilities



Tax Preparation & Filing



Prepare federal and state returns for Form 1040, Form 1120, Form 1120S, Form 1065, and Form 1041

Enter financial data accurately into Lacerte from source documents and trial balances

Review prior-year returns and roll forward carryovers, basis, and depreciation schedules

Identify deductions, credits, and tax planning opportunities

Ensure compliance with current federal and state tax law, including any mid-year regulatory changes

Client Communication



Request missing documentation from clients with clear, itemized requests

Explain tax results, balances due, and refund positions in plain language

Respond to IRS and state notices and routine filing questions

Maintain professional client service standards in all written correspondence

Quality Control & Review



Self-review returns and clear Lacerte diagnostics before submission to reviewer

Resolve discrepancies and review comments promptly

Stay current on federal and multi-state tax law changes throughout the year

Documentation & File Management



Maintain organized digital workpapers and supporting documentation

Track filing deadlines, extension deadlines, and estimated payment due dates

Document tax positions clearly enough to support reviewer sign-off and potential examination

Follow client confidentiality and data security protocols

Tax Planning Support



Assist with quarterly estimated tax calculations

Support multi-year tax projections during planning engagements

Surface planning opportunities identified during preparation work

Requirements



Active CPA license

Hands-on Lacerte tax software experience within the last 12 months (required)

Strong public accounting tax preparation background

Demonstrated experience preparing multiple return types (1040, 1120/1120S, 1065, 1041)

Working knowledge of federal and state tax law

Proven ability to handle high return volume during US tax season

Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under deadline pressure

Excellent written and verbal English communication

Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

Reliable computer (Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or higher), stable high-speed internet, quiet workspace

Dual monitor setup preferred

Nice to Have



Multi-state tax preparation and apportionment experience

Trust and estate (Form 1041) preparation experience

QuickBooks proficiency for source data reconciliation

Experience with professional tax research tools (Checkpoint, BNA, RIA, CCH)

Prior fully-remote accounting or tax preparation experience with US clients

Benefits



What We Offer



Full-time, 100% remote position

Direct exposure to US public accounting tax practice

Compensation up to $12/hour

Long-term placement with an established US-based client firm

By applying, you consent to being contacted via the contact information provided in your application for recruitment purposes only.



Interview scheduling: Initial calls run in US Mountain Standard Time (MST), within a 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM MST window (6:00 PM – 4:00 AM PHT). We genuinely appreciate your flexibility around the time difference.



Benefits:



Work from home

Experience:



Lacerte Tax Software: 1 year (Required)

US Tax Preparation: 1 year (Required)

License/Certification:



CPA License (Required)

Work Location: Remote
